> Your skill verified, your career accelerated.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Prism.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Prism.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**SkillSynapse** solves the problem of career fragmentation and "resume noise" by merging the functions of LinkedIn, Freelancer, and Internshala into a single, AI-driven platform.

Specifically, it addresses:

*   **Inaccurate Job Matching**: Uses Gemini AI to ensure a **90%+ match accuracy** between your actual skills and job requirements, moving beyond simple keyword matching.
*   **The "Trust Gap"**: Integrates a **Skill Verification** system (like the Code Verification you've seen) so you can prove your expertise to employers with verified credentials rather than just claims.
*   **Fragmented Career Tools**: Consolidates professional networking, freelance bidding, and internship hunting into one ecosystem, powered by a **Smart Profile Builder** that automatically highlights your best work.
And it's a big saving of students as they don't have to buy primium of different different platforms.

**Challenges we ran into**

We encountered several technical challenges during the setup and deployment phases:

Environment Compatibility: Running a dual-stack project (FastAPI + Next.js) on Windows required navigating shell-specific constraints, such as command separators and PowerShell execution policies for npm.
"Dual-Service" Complexity: Initially, the AI logic was split between a Python backend and a Next.js frontend. To make deployment easier and provide you with a single URL, we had to consolidate that logic into a unified Next.js API layer.
Database Migration: We had to transition from a local SQLite setup to a cloud-ready PostgreSQL configuration in the Prisma schema to ensure the app could scale in a production environment like Vercel.
Public Access Hurdles: Setting up an immediate public link was tricky because standard tools like Localtunnel required "Endpoint IP" verification (which failed for you). We resolved this by bypassing authentication entirely using a Cloudflare Tunnel, providing a direct, password-free link for testing.

**Google Cloud**

The Google Cloud track (specifically via Google Gemini and GCP infrastructure) is the "brain" of the entire SkillSynapse project. Here is how it fits perfectly:

1. Core Intelligence (Gemini AI)
The heart of the app is the Google Gemini Pro model. It doesn't just "chat"; it performs high-level reasoning for:

Hyper-Relevant Job Matching: Instead of simple keyword searches, it uses Google’s NLP to understand the nuance of a user's experience and match it to a job description.
AI Resume Generation: It acts as a professional career coach, rewriting bullet points for maximum impact.
2. Vector Analysis (Google Embeddings)
By using the text-embedding-004 model from Google, the project can convert resumes and job descriptions into mathematical vectors. This allows for:

Ranking Accuracy: Providing that "Match Percentage" (e.g., 85% Match) by calculating the distance between your skills and a vacancy in high-dimensional space.
3. Scalable Microservices
While currently running on a unified Next.js API for simplicity, the original design used a FastAPI backend that is ideally suited for Google Cloud Run. This architecture allows the AI processing to scale independently of the frontend, ensuring the app remains fast even with thousands of users.

4. A "Serverless" First Approach
By leveraging Google’s API-driven ecosystem, SkillSynapse avoids the heavy lifting of managing private AI models. This results in a project that is:

Lightweight: No need for expensive local GPUs.
State-of-the-Art: Automatically benefits from the latest Google AI updates (like the switch from Gemini 1.5 to 2.0).

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/schemesync-63c6) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Utsav-Singh-35/SchemeSync) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACKANOVA%205.O-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackanova-5-0.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AI Agents for Public Welfare Access

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Selenium](https://img.shields.io/badge/Selenium-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Government welfare programs are designed to support citizens in areas such as healthcare, education, agriculture, housing, and financial assistance. However, accessing these benefits remains extremely difficult in practice.

Three major challenges prevent citizens from effectively using these schemes:

### 1. Fragmented Information

Government schemes are distributed across hundreds of ministry and state portals. There is no unified platform that allows citizens to easily discover all available schemes relevant to them.

### 2. Complex Eligibility Requirements

Each scheme has different eligibility rules such as income limits, age criteria, occupation, category, location, and family status. Determining eligibility manually is confusing and time-consuming.

### 3. Complicated Application Process

Even when users find the right scheme, applying requires navigating complex government portals, repeatedly entering personal data, and uploading the correct documents. Many applications get rejected due to incorrect submissions or missing information.

As a result, millions of eligible citizens either *never apply* or *fail to receive benefits they qualify for*.

---

# Our Solution

*SchemeSync* is an *Agentic AI powered platform that helps citizens discover, qualify for, and apply to government schemes effortlessly.*

Instead of just listing schemes, SchemeSync acts as an *intelligent assistant* that guides users through the entire process.

### Key Capabilities

*1. Unified Scheme Discovery*
SchemeSync aggregates thousands of government schemes into a single searchable platform.

*2. Intelligent Eligibility Matching*
Users create a profile once, and the system automatically evaluates their eligibility across thousands of schemes.

*3. AI-Assisted Application Automation*
A browser assistant helps users fill application forms on external government portals using their saved profile information and documents.

*4. Smart Document Assistance*
The platform manages user documents and ensures the correct files are uploaded during applications.

---

# Impact

SchemeSync simplifies access to government welfare by removing the major barriers that prevent citizens from applying for schemes.

### Accessibility

Citizens can easily discover schemes they are eligible for without manually searching through multiple government portals.

### Efficiency

Users only need to enter their personal details once. The system automatically matches them with relevant schemes.

### Reduced Application Errors

The browser assistant helps users fill application forms correctly and upload the right documents.

### Increased Utilization of Welfare Programs

By simplifying the discovery and application process, SchemeSync can help ensure that government benefits reach the people they are intended for.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building SchemeSync required solving several complex technical challenges.

### 1. Aggregating Scheme Data

Government scheme information is scattered across multiple portals and presented in different formats. Designing a crawler that extracts and normalizes this data into a unified database required significant effort.

### 2. Designing a Flexible Eligibility Engine

Each scheme defines eligibility in different ways. We had to build a rule-based evaluation system capable of matching user profiles against thousands of schemes efficiently.

### 3. Automating Form Filling on External Portals

Government application portals vary widely in structure and design. Traditional rule-based automation would fail across different portals, so we designed a browser assistant capable of dynamically interpreting form fields.

### 4. Managing User Documents

Many schemes require specific supporting documents such as identity proofs, income certificates, or caste certificates. Designing a document management system that organizes and assists with uploads was another major challenge.

### 5. Ensuring Scalability

Handling thousands of schemes while maintaining fast search and eligibility evaluation required careful database design and indexing strategies.

**Software**

SchemeSync directly aligns with the *Agentic AI theme* by using intelligent software agents to automate complex real-world tasks.

Traditional platforms only display information. SchemeSync goes further by introducing *autonomous assistance throughout the process.*

### Archimedes
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/archimedes-61f4) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Aniket-Nikam/Archimedes/tree/master) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACKANOVA%205.O-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackanova-5-0.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Research karo India

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Llama](https://img.shields.io/badge/Llama-333333?style=flat-square) ![Groq API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Groq%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Academic researchers, students, and scientists waste 10–20 hours 
per literature review manually searching disconnected databases, 
tracing citation chains, and synthesizing findings across dozens 
of papers.

Archimedes solves this by acting as a fully autonomous research 
agent that:

- Searches 4 academic databases simultaneously (Semantic Scholar, 
  arXiv, PubMed, Google Scholar) with a single query
- Traverses multi-level citation graphs — finding not just 
  relevant papers, but who cited them and who cited those, 
  revealing the intellectual lineage of any field
- Synthesizes everything with AI — generating structured reports 
  covering methodology comparisons, contradiction maps, research 
  gaps, and field trajectories
- Saves hours of manual work — what takes a researcher a week 
  takes Archimedes under 60 seconds

Whether you're a PhD student mapping a new sub-field, an ML 
engineer benchmarking architectures, or a medical scientist 
tracking clinical literature — Archimedes gives you expert-level 
research synthesis, instantly.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Multi-model rate limiting on Groq
Groq's free tier has per-model rate limits that would silently 
fail mid-analysis. We solved this by building a 4-model fallback 
chain — every AI function automatically retries across 
llama-3.1-8b-instant → llama-4-scout → llama-prompt-guard → 
kimi-k2 until one succeeds, giving us near 99% uptime.

2. Citation graph API throttling
Semantic Scholar's API would throttle requests when we hit 
multiple papers in quick succession. We introduced deliberate 
sleep intervals (0.3–0.4s) between citation fetches and 
structured the traversal to be sequential per seed paper.

3. Deduplication across 4 databases
The same paper often appeared across arXiv, Semantic Scholar, 
and Google Scholar with slightly different titles. We built a 
title-based deduplication layer (normalized, lowercased, 
truncated to 60 chars) to avoid redundant processing.

4. Persisting rich structured reports across sessions
Storing the full report payload (papers, citation trails, 
contradiction edges, knowledge graph) in Supabase required 
serializing deeply nested JSON into message content and 
carefully deserializing it on session restore without breaking 
the UI render logic.

5. Knowledge graph rendering at scale
The force-directed Canvas graph became unstable with 18+ nodes 
due to physics simulation blow-up. We tuned the repulsion 
constants, spring forces, and damping coefficients manually 
until the graph settled cleanly for any node count.

**Software**

Why Archimedes is Agentic AI — Not Just AI
Most AI tools are reactive — you ask, they answer. Archimedes is autonomous — you give it a goal, and it acts.

1. It Plans
Archimedes doesn't just search. It first extracts the optimal search keyphrases from your conversation using Groq LLaMA, then decides how to approach the problem before touching a single database.
2. It Acts Across Multiple Systems
A true agent operates across tools. Archimedes simultaneously coordinates 4 live external APIs — Semantic Scholar, arXiv, PubMed, and Google Scholar — without any human hand-holding.
3. It Reasons
It doesn't dump raw results. It runs 5 parallel AI reasoning tasks — synthesis, contradiction detection, methodology comparison, knowledge graph extraction, and credibility appraisal — and connects them into a coherent report.
4. It Routes Itself
The Intent Router is pure agentic behavior — the system decides on its own whether to SEARCH, ANSWER from memory, or CHAT, and picks the right execution path accordingly.
5. It Has Memory
Archimedes persists conversation history and past research sessions in Supabase, injecting relevant past insights into new queries — exactly like an agent with long-term memory.

> Scroll Less. Learn More. Grow Faster.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Expo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Expo-333333?style=flat-square) ![REST API](https://img.shields.io/badge/REST%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Authentication](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Authentication-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Most social media platforms are built for entertainment, causing distraction and unproductive screen time. At the same time, professional platforms like LinkedIn focus on networking but lack engaging, short-form learning experiences. Users struggle to find a platform that helps them learn, build skills, and showcase growth in one place.

SkillReels bridges this gap.

It combines the engaging short-video experience of reels with the professional growth features of LinkedIn.

What SkillReels Enables

Short Educational Reels — Learn concepts quickly through mobile-friendly videos

LinkedIn-Style Skill Profile — Showcase skills, interests, learning history, and progress

Learning Resources Panel — Access PDFs, GitHub repos, notes, and study materials linked to each reel

AI-Powered Summaries & Roadmaps — Instantly understand topics and get step-by-step learning paths

Skill Growth Dashboard — Track watch time, topics learned, streaks, and saved content

Community Discussions — Ask questions and learn collaboratively

Save & Organize — Bookmark useful content for later

Healthy Usage Limit — Encourages productive learning instead of endless scrolling

SkillReels transforms passive social media consumption into structured, goal-oriented skill development — helping users learn efficiently, stay focused, and build a strong professional profile.

**Challenges we ran into**

One big issue was that the app only worked when my phone and laptop were on the same Wi-Fi because it depended on the Expo development server. This made real-device testing difficult. I solved it by creating a standalone APK build so the app could run independently on any phone.
Another challenge was backend integration. At first, some features looked functional but data wasn’t actually saved. I fixed this by connecting Firebase Authentication and Firestore so user data became secure and persistent.
I also found that a few buttons were responsive visually but not linked to real logic. After auditing the code and testing each interaction, I properly connected all handlers and verified flows end-to-end.
These issues helped me make the app more stable, reliable, and demo-ready.

Team **QUANTUM** -- Avneesh Kumar, Aditi Jadon, VIKRANT SHARMA

### BharatWay
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/bharatway-83b0) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/rishavchandel88/BharatWay.in.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://bharatway.netlify.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack--N--Win%203.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hacknwin-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> One App. Every Indian Road.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Many people, especially students and travelers, often face difficulty finding reliable information about places, routes, and nearby services in a simple and organized way. Most existing platforms either provide too much complex information or are not focused on helping users quickly understand their surroundings and available options.

BharatWay aims to solve this problem by providing an easy-to-use platform where users can quickly explore locations, view important places on a map, and access useful information in a simple interface. Instead of searching through multiple websites or apps, users can find what they need in one place.

This makes everyday tasks like discovering nearby locations, understanding routes, or exploring new areas much easier and faster. By simplifying location-based information and presenting it in a clear way, BharatWay helps users save time and navigate places more confidently.

**Challenges we ran into**

While working on BharatWay, one issue I faced was with the map and location feature. At the beginning, the map was not loading properly on the website and sometimes the location markers were not showing when a user searched for a place. This made the main feature of the platform difficult to use.

After checking the code, I realized the problem was related to how the map API was being called in the JavaScript file. The data from the API was loading at a different time than the map itself, which caused the markers to fail or appear late.

To fix this, I spent time debugging the JavaScript code and changed the way the API requests were handled. I added proper checks so the map loads only after the location data is available. I also cleaned up some parts of the code to make it more organized.

Once this was fixed, the map started working smoothly and users could see locations and markers correctly. This challenge helped me learn more about debugging and how APIs work with front-end applications.

Team **CODE X.AI** -- Rishav Chandel, Rachit Kumar, Sindhya .

### Napoleon-ai
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/napoleonai-0b30) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/06-preetinder/napolean-web) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack--N--Win%203.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hacknwin-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> A smart ai based web Cralwer cum osnit engine

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Selenium](https://img.shields.io/badge/Selenium-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Scrapy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Scrapy-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Today the internet contains an enormous amount of information, but finding relevant, structured knowledge from it is still extremely difficult. Traditional web crawlers simply collect pages and store raw data, leaving the user to manually analyze everything.
Our project, Napoléon, transforms web crawling into an AI-driven intelligence engine.
Instead of blindly scraping websites, Napoléon uses semantic embeddings with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 to understand a user’s research intent and evaluate every crawled page based on its contextual relevance.
As it crawls, the system performs entity extraction, keyword discovery, and automated summarization, turning unstructured webpages into structured knowledge.
We also integrate security reconnaissance, detecting potential vulnerabilities, exposed endpoints, and sensitive files during the crawl.
All collected information is then transformed into interactive dashboards, knowledge graphs, and automated research reports, allowing users to explore relationships between entities and discover insights instantly.
In essence, Napoléon doesn’t just crawl the web — it converts the web into actionable intelligence for researchers, cybersecurity analysts, and OSINT investigations.

### SBA-EVM
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/sbaevm-353f) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/RaghuChaudharyX/SBA-EVM.git) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack--N--Win%203.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hacknwin-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> “Smart Authentication for Fair Elections.”

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Problems Solved by SBA-EVM

Voter impersonation / fake voting – prevents someone else from voting in place of a registered voter through biometric verification.

Duplicate voting attempts – ensures one person = one vote using identity authentication.

Low voter participation – helps migrant workers, students, and people living away from their constituency participate more easily.

Slow manual identity verification – replaces manual ID checking with fast biometric authentication.

Human errors in voter verification – automated verification reduces mistakes by polling staff.

Lack of transparency concerns – digital records and audit trails improve trust in election results.

Complex election logistics – technology can reduce administrative workload and streamline polling processes.

Difficulty tracking voting status – system automatically marks voters as “voted”, preventing repeated attempts.

**One-line summary:

Enhances security, improves accessibility, and increases transparency in the voting process.**

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into

### 1. Secure Identity Verification Without Storing Sensitive Data
One of the biggest challenges was ensuring voter authentication while also maintaining voter privacy. Since biometric systems involve sensitive data, storing raw fingerprints would create security and privacy risks.

**Solution:**  
Instead of storing biometric data directly, we designed the system to store only **hashed authentication results** and generate an **anonymous voting token** after verification. This ensures that voter identity cannot be linked to their vote.

---

### 2. Maintaining Vote Anonymity
Another challenge was separating voter identity from the actual vote. In democratic elections, it is essential that votes remain secret.

**Solution:**  
We implemented a **dual-database architecture**:
- One database handles **voter authentication status**
- Another database stores **votes without any voter identity information**

This approach ensures that even system administrators cannot link voters to their votes.

---

### 3. Hardware Integration for the Prototype
Integrating multiple hardware components such as the fingerprint sensor, microcontroller (Raspberry Pi), and display interface required careful synchronization.

**Solution:**  
We used **Python-based hardware libraries and serial communication protocols** to manage interactions between components, allowing the authentication system and voting interface to work smoothly.

---

### 4. Simulating Aadhaar Authentication
Since real Aadhaar authentication APIs are restricted, we needed a way to demonstrate the system in a prototype environment.

**Solution:**  
We created a **simulated authentication module** that mimics Aadhaar verification logic. This allowed us to demonstrate the workflow without accessing real government databases.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/agrovisionai-a33a) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/rahul5216/AgroVision_AI.git) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://vimeo.com/1171411733?share=copy&fl=sv&fe=ci#t=0) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack--N--Win%203.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hacknwin-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Snap the Crop, Bimari Stop.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Git](https://img.shields.io/badge/Git-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**AgroVision A**I helps farmers detect crop diseases quickly using artificial intelligence and image recognition.

Many farmers cannot easily identify plant diseases in the early stages. Because of this, crops get damaged, production decreases, and farmers face financial loss. Traditional methods require agricultural experts, which are not always available in rural areas.

**AgroVision AI** solves this problem by allowing users to simply upload or capture an image of the crop leaf. The AI model analyzes the image and detects the disease instantly. It then provides possible solutions, treatment suggestions, and preventive measures.

This makes farming smarter, faster, and more efficient, helping farmers protect their crops and improve productivity.

Key Benefits:

- Early detection of crop diseases
- Instant AI-based analysis
- Easy to use for farmers
- Saves time and reduces crop loss
- Provides recommended solutions for treatment

**Challenges we ran into**

During the development of **AgroVision AI**, we faced several technical and practical challenges.

One of the main challenges was **finding and preparing a reliable dataset for crop disease detection**. Many datasets had inconsistent image quality and labeling, which affected the accuracy of the AI model. To overcome this, we carefully cleaned the dataset, removed noisy images, and used proper preprocessing techniques to improve model training.

Another challenge was **integrating the AI model with the web interface**. Connecting the image upload feature with the backend model for real-time predictions required debugging and proper API handling. We solved this by testing the API endpoints step-by-step and ensuring the model correctly processed uploaded images.

We also faced performance issues while running predictions quickly. To improve this, we optimized the model and reduced unnecessary processing so users could get faster disease detection results.

Through teamwork, testing, and continuous debugging, we were able to successfully overcome these challenges and build a functional AI-powered crop disease detection system.

Team **ShivaAi** -- Manish Kuamr, [Rahul Sharma](https://github.com/Rahul240208), Natwar Chaudhary

### KisanAI -  फसल का डॉक्टर
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/kisanai-4273) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/priyanshubisht-sudo/Kisan_AI) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://frabjous-cocada-a0903d.netlify.app/kisanai.html) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack--N--Win%203.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hacknwin-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AI Doctor for Every Indian Farmer

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

India has over 140 million farming households. Punjab alone contributes over 50% of India's wheat and rice to the central pool. Every year, farmers lose 20–30% of their crop yield to diseases they cannot identify in time.

Agricultural consultants are expensive and not always accessible
Most farmers either treat the wrong disease or wait too long
Language barriers make it hard to access online resources
No affordable, instant, bilingual solution existed - until now

KisanAI puts a crop doctor in every farmer's pocket - completely free, available instantly, and in their own language.

A farmer describes their problem in Hindi or English. KisanAI identifies the disease, explains the cause, recommends specific pesticides available in the Indian market, and gives a step-by-step treatment plan for today, this week, and next week.

**Challenges we ran into**

Our biggest challenge was the API itself. We started with Gemini but kept hitting rate limit errors mid-demo, 429s every few minutes. So we switched entirely to Groq with Llama 3.3 70B at around 1am, rewrote the API integration, fixed the response parsing, and it worked. On top of that, getting the AI to actually respond in Hindi - not just translate but think in Hindi, we required careful prompt engineering. And voice input on mobile wouldn't work until we deployed to HTTPS on Netlify because browsers block the Web Speech API on local connections.

We didn't even start with KisanAI. Our original idea was an AI mock interviewer called SkillBridge. We scrapped it two hours in because every other team had something similar. Switching ideas mid-hackathon is scary - you lose time and confidence. But we backed KisanAI because it felt real. A farmer in Punjab actually needs this. That clarity of purpose kept us moving when things broke at 2am.

Team **Recursive Rebels** -- Saksham Arora, Harman Shakarwal, [Priyanshu Bisht](https://github.com/priyanshubisht-sudo), [Prince Bisht](https://github.com/princebishtcodes)

**Challenges we ran into**

Current campus event management depends on scattered, manual processes. This causes delays, security problems from unauthorized entries, and poor audience engagement in real time.
1. Manual Entry and Security Breaches: 
problem: Students often share digital passes or use physical tickets multiple times, leading to overcrowding and "gate-crashing."
Solution: My StageVibe platform generates Encrypted QR Code Tickets. Once scanned at the entry point, the database updates the "Checked-In" status in real-time, making duplicate entries impossible.

2. Audience Experience: 
Problem: There is no bridge between the stage and the seats, often leading to sittting issue ones who come first they get their desired seats  and those who are late are not happy.
Solution: Desired seat booking and also live rating System. udience members can rate performers (1–5 stars) directly from their dashboard.

3.Logistical Issues for Organizer:
Problem: Organizers often struggle to know the exact headcount inside a venue or which performances are actually resonating with the crowd.
Solution:Multi-tier Admin Dashboards. Superadmins see live analytics- total check-ins, department-wise attendance (MCA vs. BCA), and live leaderboard scores for performers.

one of the best thing is there is superadmin and admin functionality frm backend just like real events there is organiser and volunteers.

> “Smarter Routes. Better Commutes.”

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Public transport in many Indian cities still suffers from low visibility, unpredictable crowd levels, and lack of real-time information. Commuters often face problems such as:

1. Not knowing when the next bus will arrive

2. Buses becoming overcrowded during peak hours

3. Difficulty finding reliable intercity bus routes

4. No simple way to track buses in real time

5.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7e52217b18124eff9b74ae35837a9ee6/bd192868-f38f-4875-8420-fcd34a671ed4.png) Lack of data-driven insights for transport authorities

These issues lead to long waiting times, inefficient travel planning, and poor commuter experience.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

While building Bus Connect, we faced several technical challenges related to maps, datasets, and route tracking.

1. Map Routing & Coordinate Errors

While integrating OSRM with Leaflet, routes were appearing in incorrect locations on the map. This happened because OSRM expects coordinates in longitude, latitude format, while many datasets use latitude, longitude.
We fixed this by standardizing coordinate formatting before sending requests to the routing API.

2. App Working on Localhost but Not in APK

The application worked perfectly on localhost, but several features broke when building the mobile APK. The issue was caused by datasets being stored in the wrong directory.
We solved this by moving all datasets to public/datasets/, ensuring they were correctly bundled and accessible in both web and mobile builds.

3. Incorrect Route Tracking

Initially, the tracking system filtered routes using only origin and destination, which sometimes displayed multiple routes instead of the selected one.
We resolved this by assigning a unique route ID to each bus route and using it for tracking, ensuring only the selected route is displayed.

4. Creating Realistic Transport Data

Reliable public bus datasets are limited, so building a realistic system was challenging.
To solve this, we created structured datasets with thousands of routes and integrated them with distance calculations, crowd prediction, and ETA estimation.

 Key Learnings

These challenges helped us gain deeper experience with geospatial data handling, map rendering, and large dataset integration, enabling us to build a stable prototype for smarter public transport systems.

> Emotion_Aware-Study-Assistant

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Codex 2.0 – Emotion-Aware Study Assistant helps students study more effectively by understanding their emotions during learning. Using real-time facial emotion detection through the webcam, the system identifies states like confusion, focus, or fatigue. Based on these emotions, it adapts the learning experience by suggesting breaks, offering help, or encouraging continued study. The platform also tracks focus scores, emotion history, and quiz performance to provide personalized insights about study habits. Gamification features like XP points and achievements keep students motivated. Overall, Codex 2.0 makes online learning more personalized, engaging, and efficient by responding to the student’s emotional state in real time.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge we faced while building Codex 2.0 – Emotion-Aware Study Assistant was implementing real-time emotion detection in the browser using the webcam. When we first integrated face-api.js, the emotion detection was very slow and sometimes failed to detect faces consistently. The application also started lagging because the detection process was running continuously and consuming a lot of CPU resources.

After analyzing the issue, we realized that we were using a heavy face detection model and running the detection loop too frequently. To solve this, we switched to the TinyFaceDetector model, which is lightweight and optimized for real-time browser performance. We also optimized the detection process by limiting it to around two frames per second instead of running continuously.

Additionally, we made sure that all AI models were fully loaded before starting the webcam to avoid initialization errors. After these improvements, the system became much smoother and more stable, allowing us to perform real-time emotion detection efficiently while maintaining a good user experience.

**AI / ML**

Emotion-Aware Study Assistant is an intelligent learning platform designed to make online education more personalized and effective by understanding students’ emotions during study sessions. Traditional e-learning platforms treat all students the same, without considering whether they are confused, frustrated, tired, or highly focused. This lack of emotional awareness often leads to reduced engagement and ineffective learning.

Our solution uses real-time facial emotion detection through the student’s webcam to analyze their emotional state while studying. Using face-api.js built on TensorFlow.js, the system detects emotions such as happy, focused, neutral, confused, sad, and angry. Based on these detected emotions, the platform adapts the learning experience. For example, if the system detects confusion, it can offer simplified explanations or assistance. If it detects fatigue or frustration, it suggests taking a short break to maintain productivity.

All emotion processing happens directly in the browser, ensuring privacy because no video data is uploaded to external servers.

The platform also provides personalized analytics by tracking emotional patterns, focus scores, study time, and quiz performance. Additionally, gamification features such as XP points, achievements, and quiz scoring help keep students motivated and engaged.

By combining real-time AI emotion detection with adaptive learning strategies, Codex 2.0 aims to create a more human-centered and emotionally intelligent education system.

> Clarify where news gets verified

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

ClariPress — See the Truth Behind the Headlines

ClariPress is a digital newspaper-style platform that helps users identify real news, rumors, and fake information. Using AI-powered analysis and fact-checking APIs, the system evaluates news headlines and articles and classifies them into Verified News, Rumor/Unverified, or Fake News.

With a clean editorial layout inspired by traditional newspapers, ClariPress makes it easy for readers to quickly understand the credibility of any story and explore news through search, archives, and daily updates.

**Challenges we ran into**

One challenge we faced while building ClariPress was connecting the frontend with the backend for the fake news analysis feature. The website interface was working properly, but when we tried to send the news headline or article from the frontend to the backend for verification, the request was not being processed correctly. This happened because of incorrect API request formatting and CORS restrictions between the frontend and backend servers.

To solve this issue, we created a proper API endpoint in the backend and corrected the POST request format from the frontend. We also enabled CORS middleware so the frontend application could communicate with the backend without being blocked by the browser.

Another hurdle was implementing fake news detection in a limited time. Instead of training a model from scratch, we used pretrained NLP models and fact-check APIs to analyze news content quickly. This allowed us to classify news into Verified, Rumor, or Fake and display the result directly on the ClariPress interface.

### WIRE WHISP
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/wire-whisp-d1c4) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Asura1615/wirewhisp) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtube.com/shorts/Omh7mZ8iAUk?feature=share) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACKSECURE'26-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hacksecure-1461.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Real-time Transparency for Network

![Android Studio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android%20Studio-333333?style=flat-square) ![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTTP server](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTTP%20server-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Problem Statement : LIGHTWEIGHT MOBILE NETWORK TRAFFIC ANALYZER


Problems Solved:

1. Information Asymmetry: Bridges the gap between what an app says it does and what it actually does on the wire.
2. Blind Trust Elimination: Moves the security model from "Trust Me" (app side) to "Show Me" (user side).
3. Hidden Tracker Exposure: Identifies and flags connections to known data brokers and advertising networks that are bundled into app SDKs.
4. Data Leakage Detection: Detects when sensitive information (like Auth tokens or PII) is being sent to unauthorized or high-risk geographic destinations.

The Solution (Wire Whisp)

1. Dual-Mode Interception: A 4-layer architecture built on Android’s VPN service to intercept traffic at the IP layer.
2. Passive Mode (Metadata Analysis): Monitors the "envelope" (IP, Port, Protocol, Size) to reconstruct behavior patterns without breaking encryption or compromising device security.
3. Active Mode (Deep Inspection): Uses an internal MITM Proxy (LittleProxy/Bouncy Castle) to temporarily decrypt authorized traffic, allowing users to see the actual JSON payloads and tracking pixels.
4. Real-Time Visualization: Uses MPAndroidChart and Jetpack Compose to transform raw network "flows" into a readable "heartbeat" dashboard.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Performance & Latency (The "Zero-Lag" Challenge)

The Issue: Intercepting every single packet at Layer 3 using the `VpnService` API can significantly slow down the device's internet speed and drain the battery.

The Fix: We implemented "Kotlin Coroutines" to process thousands of packets per second asynchronously, ensuring that the background analysis never blocks the user’s UI or slows down their browsing experience.


2. Breaking the "Cloak" of Encryption
 
The Issue: Modern security standards (like Certificate Pinning and HSTS) are designed to prevent exactly what we are doing—intercepting HTTPS traffic.

The Fix: We developed a dual-mode system. Passive Mode analyzes only metadata (IP/Port/Size) so we don't need to break encryption to find suspicious patterns. For Active Mode, we utilized the Bouncy Castle library to generate dynamic, per-domain SSL certificates that allow authorized decryption when the user provides explicit permission.


3. Turning Raw Data into Human-Readable Info

The Issue: Raw IP addresses (like `142.250.190.46`) are meaningless to an everyday user.
 
The Fix:We integrated "MiniDNS" to intercept and parse DNS queries in real-time. This allows us to map obscure IP addresses back to human-readable domain names like `facebook.com` or `google-analytics.com`.

> RD collection ka smart tareeka.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Figma](https://img.shields.io/badge/Figma-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Recurring Deposit (RD) agents working with post offices manage numerous customers who deposit money on a daily or monthly basis. However, most agents still rely on manual registers and paperwork to track customer deposits, installments, and collections.

This traditional method makes it difficult for agents to efficiently manage records, track pending installments, and maintain accurate financial logs. As the number of customers increases, managing these records becomes time-consuming, error-prone, and difficult to organize. Important information can be misplaced, calculations may be inaccurate, and tracking missed payments becomes challenging.

On the other hand, customers often lack visibility into their own deposit history, as they depend entirely on agents for updates. This creates a gap in transparency and makes it harder for customers to track their savings progress.

The absence of a simple digital system leads to inefficiencies, limited transparency, and operational challenges for both agents and customers.

There is a clear need for a simple, accessible, and user-friendly digital solution that can help agents manage RD records efficiently while also allowing customers to easily view and track their deposit details.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the major challenges we faced while building this project was managing accurate installment tracking for customers with different deposit frequencies (daily and monthly RD accounts).

Initially, our system treated all deposits in a similar way, which created issues when calculating remaining installments and completed payments. For example, a daily RD customer might deposit money for 28 days in a cycle, while a monthly RD customer only deposits once per month. Because of this difference, our logic sometimes displayed incorrect progress such as wrong installment counts or incorrect pending payments.

This issue became more noticeable when agents tried to quickly view how many installments a customer had already paid and how many were remaining.

How We Solved It

To fix this, we redesigned the deposit tracking logic by introducing separate tracking structures for daily and monthly RD accounts.

Each customer account now stores its deposit type (daily or monthly).

The system calculates installment progress based on the specific RD cycle rules.

We implemented a dynamic counter system that updates completed and remaining installments automatically whenever a payment is recorded.

We also added a simple progress indicator on the dashboard, which clearly shows agents and customers how many installments have been completed out of the total cycle.

Outcome

This solution significantly improved accuracy, usability, and transparency in the system. Agents can now easily track collections, and customers can clearly see their deposit progress without confusion.

# CipherGuard
### AI-Powered Parental Control System — *Team Phoenix*

---

## The Problem It Solves

Children today spend a significant amount of time online for learning, entertainment, and social interaction. However, the internet also exposes them to harmful content, cyberbullying, addictive platforms, and unsafe websites. While parental control tools exist, most of them are outdated, overly restrictive, or easy to bypass using methods such as incognito browsing, VPNs, or proxy servers.

Additionally, many existing tools only block specific websites but fail to analyze the context of content, meaning harmful images, videos, or conversations can still reach children. Parents also lack clear insights into their child's browsing behavior, making it difficult to guide safe digital habits.

CipherGuard addresses these challenges by using AI-powered detection and real-time monitoring to create a smarter and more adaptive parental control system. Instead of simple blocking, CipherGuard focuses on understanding online content and behavior, helping parents protect children while maintaining transparency and trust.

---

## What People Can Use It For

- **Safer Browsing for Children** — Actively scans web pages and media to detect harmful or explicit content and automatically blurs it before it reaches the child.
- **Real-Time Monitoring for Parents** — Parents can view their child's browsing activity, search behavior, and website usage through a centralized dashboard.
- **Preventing Access to Harmful Websites** — Filters and blocks malicious, explicit, or unsafe websites using intelligent URL classification.
- **Detecting Cyberbullying and Toxic Content** — Analyzes webpage text and messages to identify harmful language, abusive conversations, or bullying patterns.
- **Managing Screen Time and Digital Habits** — Parents can set custom limits for specific websites and monitor time spent online to reduce screen addiction.
- **Transparency and Awareness** — Provides clear insights and reports so parents can understand their child's online behavior instead of relying on guesswork.

---

## Key Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **AI-Based Image & Video Blurring** | Uses computer vision models to detect and blur NSFW images or videos in real time. |
| **Intelligent URL Filtering** | Blocks harmful websites instantly using AI-based classification and threat detection datasets. |
| **Text Content Analysis** | Analyzes text on websites and conversations to detect toxic language, cyberbullying, or abusive behavior. |
| **Incognito Mode Detection** | Alerts parents when a child attempts to use private browsing to bypass restrictions. |
| **Search & Website Activity Tracking** | Tracks search queries and visited websites to help parents understand browsing habits. |
| **Smart Website Classification** | Automatically categorizes websites into safe, educational, risky, or harmful categories. |
| **Real-Time Activity Dashboard** | Easy-to-use dashboard with usage reports and behavioral insights. |
| **Custom Time Limits** | Allows parents to set time restrictions for specific websites to manage screen time. |

---

## What Makes CipherGuard Stand Out

Most parental control tools rely on simple website blocking, which children can easily bypass. CipherGuard goes beyond traditional solutions with AI-driven content understanding and behavioral insights.

### Context-Aware Content Protection
Instead of blocking entire websites, CipherGuard detects and blurs specific harmful images, videos, or text *within* a page.

### Adaptive Blocking System
The platform dynamically adjusts filtering based on content classification and risk level, making protection smarter and more flexible.

### Incognito and Bypass Detection
Unlike many tools, CipherGuard detects attempts to evade monitoring through incognito browsing.

### AI-Generated Safety Reports
Parents receive intelligent summaries about browsing behavior, potential risks, and recommendations for safer online habits.

### Privacy-Respecting Monitoring
CipherGuard focuses on safety insights rather than intrusive surveillance, maintaining a balance between protection and trust.

### Data-Driven Parenting Insights
Instead of raw browsing logs, CipherGuard converts activity into actionable insights, helping parents guide children's digital behavior more effectively.

---

## Impact

CipherGuard transforms parental control from basic blocking tools into an intelligent digital safety system. By combining AI-powered content detection, behavioral insights, and real-time monitoring, it enables parents to protect children from online risks while encouraging healthier and safer internet usage.

**Challenges we ran into**

# CipherGuard — Development Challenges & Outcomes

---

## Challenges We Ran Into

Building CipherGuard meant going beyond basic website blocking and introducing AI-powered content understanding. This ambition brought several technical and design challenges while trying to create a secure, intelligent, and real-time parental protection system.

---

### 1. Detecting and Blurring Harmful Media in Real Time

One of the biggest challenges was implementing real-time detection of inappropriate images and videos on webpages. Web pages load dynamic media elements differently, and scanning them quickly without slowing down the browsing experience was difficult.

**Solution:** We integrated pre-trained NSFW detection models using TensorFlow and optimized the scanning pipeline so that images are analyzed asynchronously. When harmful content is detected, the extension automatically blurs the media instead of blocking the entire page, allowing safe browsing while maintaining page usability.

---

### 2. Handling Incognito Mode and Bypass Attempts

Children can easily bypass traditional parental control tools by switching to incognito or private browsing. Detecting such behavior inside a Chrome extension required careful handling because extensions have limited access to browser states.

**Solution:** We implemented incognito mode detection and alerts within the extension so that parents are notified whenever a private browsing session is initiated, ensuring transparency and preventing hidden browsing activity.

---

### 3. Real-Time Website Monitoring and Control

Tracking browsing activity in real time and enforcing rules — such as blacklisted websites or time limits — without interrupting the user experience was another key challenge.

**Solution:** We built a system where the extension continuously:

- Detects the active tab and current URL
- Tracks time spent on each website
- Sends periodic updates to the backend

The backend processes this data and sends back instructions if a website needs to be blocked or restricted, ensuring instant enforcement.

---

### 4. AI-Based Text Analysis for Cyberbullying Detection

Detecting harmful conversations and toxic language required analyzing text content across webpages and chat platforms. Raw keyword matching was unreliable and produced frequent false positives.

**Solution:** We integrated AI-based text moderation models via the **Perspective API**, which analyze context rather than just keywords. This allows the system to detect cyberbullying, abusive language, and harmful conversations more accurately.

---

### 5. Designing "SuperSafe Mode"

A key feature we introduced was **SuperSafe Mode** — an advanced protection layer that required combining multiple detection systems simultaneously.

In SuperSafe Mode:

- Harmful websites are blocked instantly
- Explicit images or videos are automatically blurred
- Toxic text or bullying content is flagged and reported
- Suspicious browsing activity triggers alerts for parents

Balancing strict protection while keeping the browsing experience smooth was challenging, but optimizing the detection pipelines helped achieve this.

---

### 6. Managing Data Flow Between Extension, Backend, and Dashboard

The system includes three major components:

| Component | Technology |
|---|---|
| Chrome Extension | Frontend content scripts |
| Backend API | Node.js |
| Parental Dashboard | Real-time analytics UI |

Ensuring smooth communication between these components required handling asynchronous data updates and maintaining consistent activity logs. We solved this by implementing structured APIs and periodic synchronization, allowing parents to view activity reports and insights in real time.

---

## Features We Successfully Built

Despite these challenges, we successfully implemented the following:

- ✅ **SuperSafe Mode** for maximum protection
- ✅ **AI-based image and video blurring** for inappropriate media
- ✅ **Intelligent URL filtering** and website blocking
- ✅ **Cyberbullying and toxic text detection** using AI models
- ✅ **Incognito mode detection** and alerts
- ✅ **Search query and website activity tracking**
- ✅ **Smart website classification** using AI
- ✅ **Custom screen time limits** for specific websites
- ✅ **Real-time parental dashboard** with usage analytics
- ✅ **AI-generated safety reports** and behavioral insights

---

## Outcome

By overcoming these technical challenges, we built CipherGuard — an AI-powered parental safety tool that provides real-time protection, intelligent monitoring, and meaningful insights. The result is a system that goes beyond traditional parental control tools and delivers smarter, adaptive digital safety for children.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

# CipherGuard — AI Help & Support Assistant

---

## Powered by Gemini API

We integrated the **Gemini API** to power the AI Help & Support Assistant within CipherGuard. This makes the support system interactive, accessible, and far more intuitive compared to traditional static help sections.

---

## What It Does

The Gemini-powered assistant enables parents to interact with CipherGuard through both **chat and voice**, allowing them to:

- Ask questions about platform features and safety settings
- Inquire about their child's browsing activity
- Get guidance on adjusting parental controls
- Resolve issues quickly with instant, intelligent responses

---

## How It Works

Gemini processes natural language queries from parents and returns context-aware, helpful responses in real time. Whether a parent types a question or speaks it aloud, the assistant understands the intent and provides clear, actionable guidance — no need to browse through documentation or static FAQ pages.

---

## Why It Matters

| Traditional Help Section | CipherGuard AI Assistant |
|---|---|
| Static, pre-written content | Dynamic, conversational responses |
| Requires manual navigation | Instant answers via chat or voice |
| One-size-fits-all guidance | Context-aware, personalized support |
| No real-time interaction | Live, intelligent back-and-forth |

---

## Impact

By integrating Gemini, CipherGuard transforms its support experience from a passive help section into an **intelligent, always-available assistant**. Parents can confidently navigate the platform, understand safety reports, and take action — all through a natural conversation.

**The problem it solves**

Traditional farming often relies on notebooks, memory, and scattered information to track crops, resources, expenses, and weather. This makes it hard for farmers to monitor crop health, plan harvests, manage inventory, and make informed decisions.

FarmaGrid solves this by providing a simple digital platform where farmers can manage crops, track resources, view weather updates, and analyze farm data in one place. With real-time insights and AI-powered recommendations, it helps farmers make smarter decisions, save time, and improve productivity.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building FarmaGrid, I faced a few challenges integrating different technologies into one smooth system. One difficulty was connecting the React frontend with the Node.js backend and managing secure authentication using JWT and OAuth, which initially caused login and token validation errors.

Another challenge was integrating external APIs like OpenWeather for weather data and Gemini AI for the chatbot, where handling API responses and errors required careful debugging.

I resolved these issues by improving API request handling, refining backend routes, and testing endpoints step-by-step. This process helped ensure stable communication between the frontend, backend, and external services, making the application work reliably.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

FarmaGrid uses the Gemini API to provide an intelligent AI farming assistant that helps farmers make better decisions. Farmers can ask questions about crop health, planting time, fertilizer usage, and disease treatment in natural language. The Gemini-powered chatbot analyzes the query and provides practical farming advice based on context.

**Best Use of ElevenLabs**

FarmaGrid uses ElevenLabs to make the AI farming assistant more accessible through voice interaction. Farmers can ask questions using voice, and the system converts speech into text, processes the query with AI, and responds with natural-sounding voice output.

**Best Use of Auth0**

FarmaGrid uses Auth0 to provide secure and reliable user authentication for farmers and agricultural managers. Auth0 helps manage user login, identity verification, and session security without building a complex authentication system from scratch.

**Best Hack Built with Google Antigravity**

FarmaGrid leverages Google technologies to build an intelligent and scalable agriculture platform. Using Google’s AI capabilities, particularly Gemini, the system provides farmers with smart recommendations about crop health, planting schedules, and weather-based decisions.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

As digital services (banking, telehealth, government portals) shift entirely online, seniors face rising security friction: forgotten passwords, failed fingerprint scans due to thinning skin, confusing 2FA codes, and vulnerability to phishing. Traditional security models assume digital literacy and physical dexterity — neither of which are guaranteed in aging populations. This creates a dangerous gap: seniors are either locked out of essential services or forced into insecure workarounds (e.g., writing down passwords).
We propose Grandparent Gateway — a five-layer, passwordless, adaptive authentication system designed with seniors, not just for them. It replaces passwords with physical tokens, passive biometrics, behavioral trust, and social recovery — all accessible via a simple web interface today, with future mobile app scalability.

This often leads to delayed responses, lost complaints, and frustration among citizens.

The Smart Grievance System addresses these issues by providing a centralized digital platform where citizens can easily report problems and track their resolution. By integrating AI-based classification, automated department routing, and real-time notifications, the system ensures that complaints reach the appropriate authorities quickly and efficiently.

This platform simplifies the complaint process for citizens while also improving coordination between municipal departments. Officers receive clearly categorized complaints, authorities can monitor performance through analytics dashboards, and administrators can manage the entire system efficiently.

Overall, the solution improves transparency, reduces response time, enhances accountability, and enables smarter city governance.

**Challenges we ran into**

Solution:
I used Firebase Firestore, which supports real-time data updates. This allowed dashboards to automatically reflect new complaints and status changes without requiring manual refresh.

**The problem it solves**

Job searching today is confusing and time-consuming. Many candidates don’t know if their resume actually matches a job description, what skills they are missing, or whether a job posting is genuine.

Matchly.ai helps solve this by acting as an AI career assistant. Users can upload their resume, compare it with job descriptions, get a match score, see skill gaps, and receive improvement suggestions. It also includes a Job Verification Agent that flags suspicious job listings and an AI Email Agent that generates personalized job application emails.

Key Points

Resume–job match score

Skill gap insights

Job authenticity check

AI-generated application emails

Saves time for job seekers

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge was building a multi-agent AI workflow where different agents handle resume analysis, job verification, and email generation while sharing data smoothly.

Another challenge was keeping AI outputs consistent for the dashboard. We solved this by improving prompts and adding validation for structured responses.

Key Points

Multi-agent AI integration

Maintaining structured AI outputs

Frontend dashboard rendering issues

Solved using prompt tuning and backend validation

> AI Phishing Detection & Awareness

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![JSON](https://img.shields.io/badge/JSON-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Phishing emails are one of the most common forms of cyberattacks. Attackers impersonate trusted organizations such as banks, companies, or government agencies to trick users into revealing sensitive information like passwords, financial details, or personal data. Many users struggle to distinguish between legitimate and malicious emails because phishing messages often use psychological manipulation techniques such as urgency, fear, authority, or rewards.

PhishPersona solves this problem by providing an AI-powered phishing detection and awareness system. The platform analyzes email content using a natural language processing model to determine whether a message is safe or potentially malicious. In addition to detection, the system identifies manipulation patterns used in phishing attempts and tracks the user's exposure to these techniques.

Users can utilize the platform to:

Detect phishing emails instantly using an AI-based classifier.

Scan Gmail emails automatically through a browser extension.

Understand phishing tactics such as urgency, authority impersonation, financial scams, reward offers, and fear-based threats.

Receive personalized cybersecurity advice based on their behavioral risk profile.

Improve phishing awareness through interactive training scenarios and simulated phishing attacks.

By combining real-time detection, behavioral analysis, and cybersecurity training, PhishPersona helps users recognize and avoid phishing attacks more effectively, making email communication safer and reducing the risk of identity theft or financial fraud.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f90ff57f85b84f0db02906381a5bcbc1/5bddbc22-e75d-4ab9-b81b-d75e7bb8aec0.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

1. PyTorch and Transformers Compatibility Issues

While integrating the BERT-based phishing detection model using the HuggingFace Transformers library, the application initially failed to run due to compatibility issues between PyTorch, Python version, and the Transformers package. This caused runtime errors when loading the model.

Solution:
The issue was resolved by creating a virtual environment and installing compatible versions of PyTorch, Transformers, and Python. This ensured the model loaded correctly and could perform inference without errors.

2. Gmail Extension Scanning the Same Email Multiple Times

During testing, the Chrome extension repeatedly scanned the same email every few seconds, which caused:

Multiple API requests

Incorrect statistics on the dashboard

Browser slowdown due to repeated processing

Solution:
A mechanism was implemented to track the unique email identifier from the Gmail URL and store the last scanned email. The extension now checks whether the email has already been scanned before sending it to the backend.

3. Incorrect Dashboard Statistics

Another issue occurred where the total email count increased every time the analyzer page was opened, even when no real email was analyzed. This caused inaccurate phishing statistics.

Solution:
Additional validation logic was added in the API to ignore empty messages, default analyzer values, and duplicate emails before updating the user profile. This ensured that only real scanned emails affected the dashboard metrics.

4. Detecting Phishing Beyond Simple Keywords

Early versions of the system relied heavily on keyword matching, which sometimes resulted in incorrect predictions. For example, legitimate emails containing words like "account" or "security" were flagged as phishing.

Solution:
The system was upgraded to use a BERT-based contextual language model, which understands sentence meaning rather than relying only on keywords. Keyword signals were then used only as a probability adjustment layer instead of the primary detection mechanism.

5. Real-Time Communication Between Extension and Backend

Connecting the Chrome extension to the Flask API initially resulted in CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) errors, preventing the browser from sending requests to the backend server.

Solution:
The Flask-CORS library was added to enable secure cross-origin communication between the extension and the Flask server.

DART: an intelligent alert enrichment and routing system. When an alert comes in, DART automatically gathers comprehensive context, user behavioral patterns, asset criticality and data classification, threat intelligence lookups, and similarities to historical incidents. ### AREE
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/aree-d90f) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://amj5owxpkkapfxv8s5scra.streamlit.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Aegis%20SandBox%20v2.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://aegis-sandbox-v.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Physics Inspired Risk Prediction Before Cascading

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Matplotlib](https://img.shields.io/badge/Matplotlib-333333?style=flat-square) ![SciPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/SciPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![XGBoost](https://img.shields.io/badge/XGBoost-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Modern cloud infrastructure runs on dozens of interdependent microservices. When something goes wrong  a CPU spike, a brute-force login attempt, a sudden traffic surge  existing tools like SIEM, SOAR, and AIOps platforms raise individual alerts. But they do it in complete isolation.
AREE ( Autonomous Risk Evolution Engine ) introduces an entirely new paradigm: modeling infrastructure risk as dynamic energy that accumulates, propagates, and dissipates.

**Challenges we ran into**

1.  The Reinforcement Learning Loop Broke Our Own Demo:
Our most ambitious feature  a self-adapting Q-Learning loop that updates Risk Energy weights after every intervention  sounded brilliant until it ran live. The Q-table refused to converge under 20 training episodes, and in one test run the weights drifted negative, causing RE scores to spike past 200 instead of stabilizing. Our system was actively making the infrastructure worse.
The fix: We replaced full Q-Learning with a lightweight reward-based heuristic            update:

if (RE_before - RE_after) / RE_before > 0.3:
    weights["TES"] += 0.05

Stable. Visible. Demo-able in 10 seconds. We preserved the full RL architecture in our codebase and documentation as the production roadmap judges respected the honesty, and the simplified version still demonstrated genuine self-optimization across live episodes
2.  Dependency Graph Recursion Crashed Minikube Mid-Demo
Our DSS (Dependency Sensitivity Score) propagates risk recursively across a NetworkX dependency graph. Beautiful in theory  catastrophic at scale. Testing on a 15-service topology hit O(n²) complexity, memory maxed out on Minikube, and the dashboard froze completely. During a mock run. In front of the team.
The fix: We introduced a 3-hop depth cap with exponential decay per hop:

Auth RE=80 → Payment RE=64 → Checkout RE=51 → DB RE=41
            (×0.8)          (×0.8²)          (×0.8³)

Risk naturally dissipates with graph distance which is physically accurate and computationally efficient. Locked demo topology to 8 services. Zero crashes after that.
3.  90% False Positive Rate Everything Was "Critical"
When we first trained our Isolation Forest on pure Faker-generated synthetic logs, it flagged nearly every data point as anomalous. The Streamlit dashboard was a wall of red. Risk Energy pegged at 95 for a completely idle system. The model had learned nothing real.

The fix: We switched the threat classifier training to NSL-KDD  a real labeled cybersecurity dataset  and used Faker only for data augmentation, not as the primary source. Added Pandas z-score normalization as a preprocessing gate and tuned contamination=0.05 on Isolation Forest. False positive rate dropped dramatically. The dashboard finally showed green services with localized red spikes  which is exactly the visual story AREE needs to tell.

4.  Is This Just Fancy Anomaly Detection?
Halfway through Day 2, one of our own teammates asked it. And we didn't have a clean answer. Our pitch was technically correct but the propagation and evolution angle wasn't coming through in the demo. It looked like a prettier Grafana dashboard.
​

The fix: We built a side-by-side A/B simulation  the same cascade scenario run through a standard threshold alerting system vs. AREE. The threshold system fired 3 isolated alerts and missed the cascade. AREE detected the compound instability pattern 28 minutes earlier and auto-stabilized before payment service was affected. We made that comparison the opening shot of our demo. The just anomaly detection question never came up again.

5.  The Physics Felt Like a Metaphor, Not a Model
Early feedback: "Thermodynamics is cool storytelling  but where's the empirical grounding?" Our entropy dissipation factor λ was chosen arbitrarily (λ = 0.03). If a judge pushed on it, we had no real answer.
​

The fix: We ran 50 simulation episodes and measured actual post-intervention RE decay curves against different λ values. Empirically landed on λ = 0.04 as the best fit. More importantly, we added the natural cooldown curve to the live Streamlit dashboard.

Team **IntelloQ** -- [Khitiz Sahoo](https://github.com/ktzsid10), [Deepanshu Sharma](https://github.com/Deepanshu911), [Anirudh .](https://github.com/anirudh-codes26), [Kriti Singh](https://github.com/kriti-212)
